## Summary

Wayfarer Fintech Ltd (policy CC-1407): theft from an unlocked desk of a camera body and lens at the insured's office on Harbour Lane. Declined under exclusion 7.1.

## Facts

Wayfarer Fintech Ltd reported the loss on 10 September 2026 [notice of loss]. The loss occurred at the insured's office on Harbour Lane [notice of loss]. The items are a camera body and a lens [invoice 1], [invoice 2]. The theft was reported to the police on 12 September 2026 under reference CR/2026/4143 [police report]. The items were taken from an unlocked desk, were left in a shared area, and were not in a locked container [police report].

## Coverage analysis

The loss is theft of business contents at the insured's office, which falls within clause 4.2 of the policy [notice of loss], [policy]. The policy schedule is not in the file, and the decision below does not depend on it.

Exclusion 7.1 applies. It removes cover for theft of portable equipment left unattended in a shared or public space unless the equipment was in a locked container or locked room [policy]. The items were left in a shared area and were not in a locked container [police report]. Nothing in the file shows a locked room.

Exclusion 7.5 does not apply. The loss was reported to the police on 12 September 2026, two days after the notice of loss and within seven days [police report], [notice of loss], [policy].

Exclusion 7.3 does not apply. The loss is alleged to be theft, not gradual deterioration [notice of loss], [policy].

## Decision

Not covered: exclusion 7.1 applies. The claim is declined, and the insured is told why in the terms of the policy.

## Reserve

No reserve is set: the claim is declined.
